paras: If you are still riding that old Icy Blue Mechanostrider Mod A, then you will surely want to turn it in for a newer model. Your new swift mechanostrider keeps all the same speed that the old one has with a brand new look. You can browse the swift mechanostriders here to see the great looks you will have to choose from.
